title: Price comes right after photos
problem: Pricing sat below six specification groups, far down the product form.
now: Pricing is the third card, right after Media; everything else stays in place.

steps.eval: (async () => { for (let i = 0; i < 4; i++) { const b = document.querySelector('.mn-x'); if (!b) break; b.click(); await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 300)); } })()
